title: Basic Elements Of Planning
modules: Theories Of Internal Structure Of Cities
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the administrative heads and they exercised control of their subject through Native laws and customs."
The traditional rulers are the administrative heads and they exercised control of their subject through Native laws and customs.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a catalyst to socio-economic development, therefore its planning and development influence the degree of accessibility and efficiency of other land uses."
Transport is a catalyst to socio-economic development, therefore its planning and development influence the degree of accessibility and efficiency of other land uses.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means not less than a 20 years plan period."
Long range in most communities means not less than a 20 years plan period.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the product of the transport industry."
Safe arrival is the product of the transport industry.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the detailed layout of the various local areas (zones) contained in the urban plan."
Local Planning Local (land-use) planning is concerned with the detailed layout of the various local areas (zones) contained in the urban plan.
fib: ______ is a process that involves the movement of commuters, goods and services from a given point of origin to a specific destination.
Transportation itself is a process that involves the movement of commuters, goods and services from a given point of origin to a specific destination.
______ is a function of land-use, the reciprocal statements that land use is a function of transports is also true.
Just as transport is a function of land-use, the reciprocal statements that land use is a function of transports is also true.
______ is an important land use itself and so critical to performance, and convenience of other land uses.
Transport indeed is an important land use itself and so critical to performance, and convenience of other land uses.
______ is a regulation of uses of land, allowing government through the local planning agencies or council to exercise stronger control over the use of and in a particular community.
Zoning is a regulation of uses of land, allowing government through the local planning agencies or council to exercise stronger control over the use of and in a particular community.
